pages.name: Spin
pages.overview: Spin focuses on outranging your enemies while also taking care of your rage bar, as your moveset uses it the most.

moves.name: Harnessing The Spin
moves.does: The player charges up a spin ball. This is a held move and once used for the first time will show a green meter next to the player until they use an ability that is not an M1. When the player would use a move that is not Q or M1, they will use up all the charge and empower that ability’s damage by a percentage that depends on the meter’s fullness. If it was maximum, the damage would be increased twofold. This move burns the meter at 1 meter per percentage and burns it fast.

moves.name: Rush Attack
moves.does: Five hit strings combo that ends in knockback.

moves.name: Off-Mode Barrage
moves.does: Rapid flurry that pushes the opponent back.

moves.name: On-Mode Heavy Strike
moves.does: Slow, powerful hit with a long wind-up.

moves.name: Lesson Two
moves.does: The player swings forward a punch, if landed, the enemy will be knocked back. This can lead to combo extend with projectiles. Has armor. Get Off me tool

moves.name: Focused Energy
moves.does: The player  punches forward with both fists. If this were to connect to an enemy, the enemy will spin on themselves and then be ragdolled.

moves.name: Curved Shot
moves.does: The player throws a curved steel ball that tracks to the nearest opponent, dealing damage if lands and stunning very little. This move only has a 6 second cooldown. The animator should make two different animations, one where they shoot left and one where they shoot right. If the first cast of this move was left shot, then the other will be a right shot

moves.name: Focused Energy
moves.does: The player throws a steel ball forward that comes back to them. If on the way back this ball would hurt an opponent, that opponent will be launched into the player, where the player will land a Spin infused punch, ragdolling.Of course, it can also hit enemies when thrown, but won't come back to the user and as such will not do the grab part.

moves.name: Overflowing Energy
moves.does: The player throws a steel ball projectile with weight that when it sticks to a surface will explode into a tornado, sending anyone inside of it upwards while ragdolling them. If the player goes inside, they will be lifted up.

moves.name: The Golden Ratio
moves.does: The player crouches as they hold their hand out to harness energy from the ground, where a golden ratio is drawn, if uninterrupted, they will be rewarded with 50 meter

moves.name: Medicinal Function
moves.does: This move is a holdable move. The player puts their hands on their arm and channels spin energy, Healing them at a rate of 1 HP per 2 Meter rapidly.

pages.name: Mandom
pages.quote: Welcome to the true man's world.
pages.overview: Mandom focuses on punishing your enemies from afar and using your utility to mess with your enemy.

moves.name: True Man's World
moves.does: The player plays with their watch, after a short startup, everyone in a timestop radius will go back to their previous place,state, and hp 6 seconds ago, all enemies will be stunned for 3 seconds.

moves.name: Rush Attack
moves.does: The player pulls out their gun and does a combo of pistol whips forward, ending with a short lived shot that deals knockback (the shot is not a projectile and is just a visual).

moves.name: Quickfire
moves.does: The player quickly pulls out their gun and shoots 6 short live projectile rounds, the rounds have enough stun to combo extend. Acts like your barrage

moves.name: Stompdown
moves.does: The player stomps the ground, hitting ragdolled opponents and ragdolling them again (bonus damage move, can also hit awake opponents)

moves.name: Focus Strike
moves.does: The player puts their hand on their holster and focuses for a maximum of 3 seconds (Held move). Once the player lets go, they will fire a quick shot that deals ragdoll however, if it were to interrupt an ability, will stun the opponent, NO MATTER if the move had hyperarmor or not.

moves.name: High Noon
moves.does: The player pulls out their gun and get ready to fire at any moment for as long as they hold this move. Enemies near the player will get a circle that slowly becomes smaller and smaller, ending with a skull if the circle becomes too tiny. Once the player lets go, they will fire a shot at every enemy who has been marked, dealing damage depending on the size of the circle, going from 15 DMG to a maximum of 150 DMG for the skull, deals small stun.

moves.name: Final Showdown
moves.does:
The player stands still and focuses, if hit during this, a cutscene will begin where they dodge the blow by moving their head and then do a liver blow to the enemy, pushing them back. The player will then throw a backup gun to the opponent and they will catch. After this, a minigame will start for both players, 

Here is how it works. Players stand still and wait for one of them to press M1, either player can do this at any time, players can also press M2 as a counter, Once a player press M1, a subtle and quick animation of them pulling out their gun and shooting will appear, giving the time for the other player to counter. If this were to hit a player, then they will be dealt 200 DMG and be dealt ragdoll, however. Dodging can lead to a counter fire, which of course, the player who shot can dodge.

The camera during this part of the cutscene is almost like a 2d view of both players. Animation Wise, this move should be divided into these parts.

1- The counter
2- First Cutscene
3 - Idle during minigame
4- Counter during minigame (By user)
5- Counter during Minigame (By defender)
6 Shooting
7 Being shot

moves.name: Backup
moves.does: The player uses mandom and reverses themselves to the position they were when they used their last move. They will then use that move again. Note that the enemies do not wind back, additionally, you have to use this move in a 10 second time between using the move or you will not be able to wind back

pages.name: Tusk ACT IV
pages.quote: Gyro, for this reason… this was the reason for “lesson 5”. Thank you… Thank you, Gyro. I truly… truly… thank you… I can’t find any other words to express it.
pages.overview: Tusk focuses on hyper rushing down your opponent and not leaving them space. If they ever try getting away from you, you can get them back into your hold by shooting your projectiles towards them.

moves.name: "I Will Call This Tusk"
moves.does: Below your rage bar lies 10 nail pictures. This is a meter used in Tusk's moveset. Nails restore themselves one at a time and do it slowly.

moves.name: Rush Attacks
moves.does: The player attacks 5 times, with the last dealing knockback

moves.name: Rush Attacks
moves.does: Tusk attacks 5 times, the last hit ragdolling

moves.name: Furious Strike
moves.does: The Stand barrages forward, ending with a punch that deals knockback.

moves.name: Wormhole Manifestation
moves.does: The player aims and then shoots a nail forward. If this were to hit a player, Tusk will come out and barrage them, ending with a punch that ragdolls. If this hits a surface, it will create a wormhole that tries to move towards the closest enemy, ragdolling them when in contact. The player can freely move and use moves without tusk while Tusk is barraging.

moves.name: Rampaging Destruction
moves.does: Tusk tries grabing forward. If landed, it will choke the enemy, spin on itself and then run the enemy into the pavement. Tusk will then detach itself from the user and glide forward while having the enemy hit the pavement, throwing them away after a short time. The player can freely move and use moves without tusk for the second part of the move.

moves.name: Golden Shot
moves.does: The player charges up a nail and then fires it forward, ragdolling anyone hit to the floor

moves.name: Nail Shot
moves.does: The player shoots a nail forward, Holding this move will fire more nails, skipping the startup

moves.name: Spatial Harassement
moves.does: The player points at the sky and shoots nail up above. The nearest enemy will then have a black cylinder under their feet that gets smaller, Once it becomes small enough, the fired nail will come down, creating a wormhole in the ground where tusk appears to try and punch the enemy through, ragdolling if landed.

moves.name: Looming Destruction
moves.does: Tusk punches forward. If this hits an enemy, the enemy will be Soft Knocked tusk will  come from behind, grabbing their head and throwing them towards the user. During the second part the player can freely move and use moves without tusk.

moves.name: Infinite Rotation
moves.does: Tusk punches the ground beneath the user, creating an AOE that ragdolls. The main purpose of this move is the following. A giant wormhole will then be created where the ground was smashed for 10 seconds that pulls enemies towards it center, slowly damaging them. Can pull in ragdolled enemies and enemies in I-Frames. Does not stun

moves.name: Wormhole Traveling
moves.does: The player shoots nail into their head and then fall into a wormhole. If not cancelled, the player will become a fast moving wormhole that can climb any surface (Can cling to walls). While in the hole, the player can use any moves that can be done with their hand, having the player's hand come out of the hole and do the animation. Pressing H will cancel this move and exit out of the wormhole, Lasts for a max of 6 seconds. Hitting the wormhole will make the player exit.

moves.name: The Final Lesson
moves.does:
The player poses with tusk and then fire a nail forward (Not mouse aimed). If  this hits someone, a cutscene will begin.

The enemy will be flown into the air, where tusk will be summoned and barrage the enemy. Tusk will then punch the enemy even higher into the air. The camera will then go to first person of the enemy, where they will see Tusk flying rapidly towards them in a punch position. Once close enough, tusk will punch downward, sending the enemy into the pavement.

If this was to kill, the following happens

Tusk comes down from the air and starts barraging the enemy, ending with a final punch. that kills the enemy and shatters the ground in a wide area. The player will then start to cry, only to see their roblox friend in the sky (Make them transparent), letting out a final goodbye.

moves.name: Lesson V
moves.does: Tusk glides forward, if it meets with an enemy, tusk will grab the enemy, send them into the sky, teleport above and barrage them from above, ragdolling the enemy after. During the second part, the player can freely move and use moves without tusk

moves.name: Moveres Crus
moves.does: The player puts their hand on the ground and then use the power of spin to propel themselves toward their cursor's position

moves.name: Herbal Tea
moves.does: The player pulls out a cup of tea and drinks it, restoring 3 Nails, this move has a very low cooldown.

pages.name: Love Train (New Moves Only)
pages.quote: What will happen now is a sacrifice… you! Johnny Joestar… The trial will... end with the spilling of blood…
pages.overview: Love train focuses on proecting itself and delivering counter blows.

moves.name: Unwavering Heart
moves.does: The player puts their hand up and creates a wall with love train. This wall will block off any projectile and stun enemies who stood inside of it.

moves.name: Love Train
moves.does: [The player spins and then poses, if uninterrupted, they will enter LOVE TRAIN for 1 second per 4 Rage bar consumed with this ability. While in love train, any damage that would be dealt to you will be redirected near you as an Aoe explosion that deals small stun. If you were to have a flag put down from misfortune redirection, the Aoe will instead always be casted there and will be bigger in size.

moves.name: Missfortune Redirection
moves.does: The player throws a flag forward into the ground for 4 seconds. During this time, any projectile (including from the user’s moveset) will be redirected towards an enemy if it passed through the flag.

moves.name: New Move
moves.does: The player does a 5 hit combo forward, last hit dealing knockback and breaking block.

moves.name: Rush Attacks
moves.does: The Hand does a combo of strikes forward, the last ragdolling and breaking block.

moves.name: Dropkick
moves.does: If used on the ground, the player will charge up and then dropkick forward, ragdolling anyone hit, if they however use this will being the air the user will dropkick downward with the damage of the ability being related to how long the user was in the air.

moves.name: One Two
moves.does: The player punches forward, if landed the opponent will have their shirt be grabbed and the hand will appear and punch, dealing ragdoll.

moves.name: No Sweat
moves.does: While the player still has their hands in their pocket, they kick forward, if they were to hit anyone, that opponent will be dealt knockback (like ge Futile Barrage). If they were to have hit an opponent who used an ability, the hand will then appear out of the player’s body and pull in the enemy, stunning them. This ability cancels and goes through regular armor (IFRAMES are not regular armor).

moves.name: Repeated Assault
moves.does: The player readies their fist and punches forward, if landed, a grab will begin where the enemy gets launched back and the player gets a QTE to their G key, if they press it in time, the enemy will be pulled back to the user and they will punch again, knocking back. This sequence can continue to a maximum of 10 times, where the punch will be a strong right that ragdolls the opponent far away, with the user then doing a cutscene between both of them taunting (Like usg QTES). Failing the sequence will just leave the enemy out of the grab, ending it.

moves.name: Punk Tactics
moves.does:
The player kicks forward, if landed the enemy will knocked back and The Hand will stomp them onto the ground from above and kick their head in, after this barrage of kicks The Hand will kick the opponent to the user where they will grab the enemy and headbutt them, ragdolling and dealing massive damage. If this were to kill, The hand will pull the enemy back to the user where they will then punch them and repeating this for a while, ending with an erasure punch that deletes the opponent.

(The current beatdown, if budget doesn't allow for a second beatdown then this just becomes universal)

moves.name: Grunt Move
moves.does: the player kicks the ground, waking up any opponent from a ragdoll state, if this then happens, The hand will come out and land a liver shot on the enemy, stunning them. (A mini grab)

moves.name: Furious Strikes
moves.does: Regular Barrage

moves.name: Erasure Swipe
moves.does: The Hand swipes forward and ragdolls any opponent hit, during the startup of this ability, the player can hold it to  make it so that The Hand and the player also move forward while swiping. (Unlike the current version the dash is active while the hitbox also is, making it a moving hitbox). Held variant when used in the air will make the user stay in the air and then send them where they are looking

moves.name: Erasure Pull
moves.does: The hand swipes forward, erasing the space between you and the enemies, as such, any enemy forward will be pulled towards you and be stunned. However, if this would pull a ragdolled opponent, the opponent will be pulled and be ragdolled to the floor. This ability can also pull people who are using moves, including beatdowns or awakenings.

moves.name: Garden Warfare
moves.does: The Hand pulls in garden pots toward itself, hitting anybody in between the player and the pots, ragdolling them, this ability has 360 blocking. The pots can hit the player aswell

moves.name: Ground Ripper
moves.does: The Hand swipes upward, creating a pillar that if it hits an opponent, will impale them and stun them for a medium period of time, can hit ragdolled. If this misses, the spike will stay as a CONE object. Very similar to the one ingame.

moves.name: Time Fabric Erasure
moves.does: After some startup, The Hand erases the concept of time for a very short period of time, this has all of the properties of regular time stops.

moves.name: Space Erasure
moves.does:
The hand readies up and then swipes forward, if landed a cutscene will begin where the following happens. The enemy gets hurt and The Hand kicks them forward, sending them away from the user, after this. The player will taunt the enemy and the camera will show TH’s Hand charging up. After this, an interactive part will begin where the player can press WASD to swipe the enemy to a different direction, dealing damage to them from hitting the ground or environment. W to go up, A to go left, S to go down and D to go right. During this part of the beatdown the cutscene has gone away and players are in their regular gameplay cam. After 5 seconds, the cutscene camera will come back and The Hand will swipe the enemy to the player. Once the enemy comes back, The player will land a mean right hook on them, ragdolling them and ending the beatdown. 

If this were to kill, instead of punching the opponent when they come back, TH will grab the opponent by the head and throw them forward. After this, we will see from the enemy’s POV the player using TH to erase the space between them and the enemy, where the player will just end up teleporting to the enemy and grabbing them. After this, they will let go of the enemy and erase both legs, making the enemy crawl on the floor. The player will then charge up a big erasure and erase the entire body of the enemy.

NOTE: The damage on this beatdown is very varied, since most of it comes from the interactive part, as such spamming it would get you the most damage and doing nothing will basically deal the same amount as a heavy punch.

NOTE: During the interactive part a popup should tell them to press their keybind, and a timer telling them how much time they have left.

moves.name: Low Swipe
moves.does: The Hand sweeps the floor while erasing it in hope of hitting someone’s legs. If this does hit someone, they will be crippled and not be able to run for a short period

moves.name: Absolute Erasure
moves.does: The player stomps the ground and starts charging up an erasure for a full 15 seconds, after this startup, The Hand will create a huge erasure that ONE SHOTS any opponent hit by it, this ability has IFRAMES, Can bypass blocking states or counters AND IFRAMES

pages.name: Crazy Diamond
pages.quote: You bastard... What the fuck did you say about my hair?!?!
pages.overview: Crazy Diamond wishes to rush down the opponent and not leave them with space, alot like his uncle's own stand. However, your ability also lets you heal allies, so don't forget to help your buddies. I should say don't let them diss your hair, but you want that to happen.

moves.name: Rush Attacks
moves.does: The player does a 5 hit combo, the last strike knockbacking and breaking block

moves.name: Rush Attacks
moves.does: The Stand does a 5 hit strike combo, the last hit dealing ragdoll and breaking block

moves.name: Sudden Strikes
moves.does: The player does a very short dash forward while casting a hitbox, if this hits someone, the player will stop their momentum and CD’s arms will come out and barrage the enemy, ending with a knockback punch, crazy diamond spawns on the enemy and not the player, the player can freely move and use m1s during the barrage. If blocked this move will still activate

moves.name: Blood Reconstruction
moves.does: To use this ability, you need to have dealt ragdoll to an enemy in the last 10 seconds, if you haven't, a popup will go on your screen telling you this. If you have, then you will pull out blood from the enemy and reconstruct it into a dagger that you can use as M1s, they have a 1.25x damage multiplier, but also, you can press T again to throw them, dealing ragdoll and bypassing block.

moves.name: Play Catch
moves.does: The player flips forward (they travel forward while in the air above), once landed, they will do a kick backwards, if landed, a grab will start where crazy diamond picks up the enemy and throws them back at the player, where they will punch the enemy in the gut, stunning them.

moves.name: Slide Kick
moves.does: The player slides forward, stunning anybody hit and making them travel with the user, after the slide, the player will do an upward kick, sending the opponent upward while stunned.

moves.name: Furious Strike
moves.does: Regular Barrage

moves.name: Bearing Shot
moves.does: Crazy Diamond shoots a little ball forward, dealing a small stun, can bounce on terrain, causing it to auto aim to its nearest enemy. Can also be held to increase its stun duration and damage. At max held it will break block

moves.name: In My Range
moves.does: Crazy Diamond detaches from the player and gets ready to punch, if it meets an opponent during its course, both players will enter a grab where Crazy Diamond barrages the opponent and then launches them upward, ragdolling.

moves.name: Shining Destruction
moves.does: Crazy Diamond grabs forward, if landed, then the enemy’s head will be grabbed and CD will slam them into the ground, ragdolling them to the floor.

moves.name: Rock Trap
moves.does: A visible red circle in a medium AOE appears around the player (The Circle is like 1/3  of a timestop radius) and the player and stand get ready to punch the floor. Once the inner circle is big enough to hit the circle outlines, the player can press H again to cause CD to barrage the floor, making everyone who is in the circle to become a rock statue for 6 TRUE seconds. True stun means that getting hit will not cancel the stun, during these seconds they cannot be grabbed or else the rock will get broken and the true stun will end. Can hit ragdolled opponents

moves.name: Fair Play
moves.does:
The player points forward and crazy diamond punches forward (downward looking punch). If this is successful, a cutscene will begin where the enemy gets knocked to the floor and the player will walk towards them. Once they arrive at the enemy, they will crouch and do a chin punch to the enemy, causing the enemy to wanna crouch away from the player, however Crazy Diamond will merge them with the nearby floor, rendering their legs useless, they will then throw rocks near them to the player, however Crazy Diamond’s arm will block it, the player will then walk again towards them (the enemy crouching made them go away a little bit) and heal them up to max HP. The enemy will then stand up and look confused, looking at their arms (the camera will show the enemy’s POV) and then they will look forward rapidly because Crazy Diamond comes out of the user and delivers a strong punch, stunning them (after this camera returns to normal cutscene). Crazy Diamond will barrage the enemy rapidly and end with a strong punch. The final punch deals the regular beatdown damage but also deals the amount of damage that was healed during the cutscene.] 70 Meter

If this were to kill, after the final punch, the enemy will fly upward and fall down to the floor. The player will then crack their knuckles and walk forward while doing so, they will tell the opponent to stand up, the opponent will stand up and look worried. The player will then get into a battle ready position and taunt the opponent to fight them 1 on 1, however the opponent will just turn the other way and start running, the player will then summon Crazy Diamond to quickly impale the enemy, killing them.

moves.name: Double Trouble
moves.does: Crazy Diamond does a stunning liver punch forward and then a heavy punch with the other arm, dealing ragdoll, if an enemy was hit by the first part they will always get hit by the second part, no matter if they are in the hitbox or not.

moves.name: Joe's Pride
moves.does: The player touches up their hair, if they were to get hit during this, a short cutscene will happen for the attacker and the player where they will turn their head to the enemy and look pissed off. After this they will enter Berserk Mode for 25 seconds, they also get new running and walking animations.

moves.name: Read
moves.does: All moves not included here stay the same as in Stand On, however they heal instead of dealing damage.

moves.name: Heal And Pull
moves.does: Crazy Diamond swipes forward, if it hits anyone, they will be healed and launched away, only to be brought back to the player stunned, can hit multiple people. Extends and resets your m1s

moves.name: Read
moves.does: The player cannot go into stand off during rage mode, also, all moves not changed from Stand On here will stay as they are, but with a 1.25x Damage boost.

moves.name: Rock Trap
moves.does: This move has no startup now

moves.name: Anger Management
moves.does: The player walks forward in anger with audible footsteps, after 3 steps, they will do a forward kick forward. If landed, a cutscene will begin where the enemy steps back in back, and sees the player running towards them, they will then start to run away from the player but after a short while trip on a rock, this rock will however get merged with their foot, making them stunned and in a falling position, almost about to hit the floor. The player will then walk around them and go in front of them, they will then summon CD to punch them in the chin, the enemy’s head will go back and the player will pick their head up and make Crazy Diamond continue punching the enemy (CD will barrage), it will then do a strong punch that sends the opponent away (since the player was behind the enemy, they will do a short sidestep before the punch gets done). Deals heavy damage and ragdolls.

pages.name: Killer Queen
pages.quote: You ants really think you can find Yoshikage Kira? I'll destroy you. My Stand Killer Queen's Sheer Heart Attack will kill anything it aims for, guaranteed.
pages.overview: Killer Queen plays reactively, see what your opponent does and punish them for making mistakes. Pay close attention to your meter so don't waste it for no reason.

moves.name: Switch: On
moves.does: The player does an animation and then detonates anyone with the detonation mark, ragdolling them, this ability does not make an AOE.

moves.name: Rush Attacks
moves.does: The player does a 5 hit combo, last strike dealing knockback and breaking block

moves.name: Drive By
moves.does: The player summons SHA to drive forward on the ground. If it were to hit an enemy in its path, it will jump into them and drill them with its nose, stunning. Cannot be used if SHA is on the field. After summoning SHA the player can freely move.

moves.name: Higher Up
moves.does: The player stomps down, making any opponent hit be ragdolled to the floor, can also hit opponents who are ragdolled.

moves.name: Sheer Heart Attack
moves.does: The player points forward and summons SHA who will jump out of their shoulder and lunge forward, if SHA were to hit anyone, the enemy will be knocked into the ground and SHA will explode on them, dealing ragdoll damage. Cannot be used if SHA is on the field already. The player can move freely after SHA is summoned.

moves.name: Team Assasination
moves.does: The player does an elbow strike forward, if landed, the enemy will be soft knocked (Like shove in tsb) and KQ will appear behind them to chop an arm. This attack makes the enemy go far enough for both players to enter neutral again, as such it should be used like a neutral or combo ender move.

moves.name: Summon: SHA
moves.does: The player crouches down and summons SHA, SHA will automatically target the closest target, however it prefers the target with the KQ Detonation Mark. Once it reaches a target, it will explode, dealing ragdoll damage and bypassing blocking. This ability cannot be used if SHA is already on the field.

moves.name: Staining The Pavement
moves.does: The player swipes forward, if landed, a cutscene will begin where the player slams the opponent repeatedly into the floor. Ending by grabbing the enemy from the collar and throwing them away.

moves.name: Rush Attacks
moves.does: The stand does a five hit combo, last hit ragdolling and breaking block

moves.name: Furious Strikes
moves.does: Killer Queen does a barrage, ending with a strong punch that does knock and applies the detonation mark

moves.name: Crime Scene
moves.does: Killer Queen grabs forward, if landed they will place a detonation mark, impale the enemy and throw them away

moves.name: Killing Blow
moves.does: Killer Queen swipes downward, chopping an arm if landed, if this is successful, it will follow up with a grab where it kicks the enemy (like when someone kicks a door), ragdolling them and applying the detonation mark.

moves.name: A Killer's Need
moves.does: KQ swipes forward, if landed, the player will have a limited amount of time to detonate the enemy, exploding one of their limbs (legs/left arm), stuns if the detonation is successful, if not it will stun for a very small amount. If this were to kill a target, a finisher cutscene will begin where the enemy blows up all in flame and only leave their arm on the floor. The player will then walk to it, crouch and put the arm in their suit sleeves.

moves.name: Mass Detonation
moves.does: KQ detaches from the player and charges forward, if this connects KQ will throw the enemy to the player and a grab will begin. The player grabs the opponent’s head and then throws them onto the floor. Right as the enemy hits the floor, the player will be able to press Switch On (This requires timing, a visual effect will show when to press M3), if they successfully do the Switch On, then the enemy will detonate and bounce into the air and come back to the ground, where the player can do it again. This can be done up to 6 times.

moves.name: No Weakness
moves.does: Killer Queen points upward, charges up and then touches forward, if landed, a cutscene will begin where the enemy gets put into the floor and the player will detonate the bomb while walking backwards, thinking that the opponent is dead. However, the opponent will stand up and say to the player that they aren't finished, the player will then put their hand on their head to slick it back. After this, Killer Queen will charge forward and punch forward, hitting the enemy. This will start a fight sequence where the enemy summons their stand (or if they do not have a stand they will do the enemy stand animation themselves). The enemy’s stand will then punch forward, but get blocked by KQ, this happens for a short while, after this, the enemy stand will try landing a strong punch to KQ’s head but kq will dodge it, grab the stand’s arm and then throw them to the floor, where they will detonate the opponent to make them bounce upward, where KQ will land a final forward kick.

moves.name: Detonator Jump
moves.does: The player crouches and then creates an AOE explosion that stuns and sends the player into the air. This is more of a short hop than a mobility tool to get up buildings.

moves.name: Pocket Change
moves.does: The player picks up coins from their pockets and then throws them forward and detonates them, creating a wall AOE that stuns opponents

moves.name: Place Bomb
moves.does: The player crouches and touches the floor, creating a mark that only the player can see on where they used the move. If the player uses Switch On, the mark will detonate into a large AOE that ragdolls opponents but after waking up will stun them.

pages.name: KQ: Bites The Dust
pages.quote: Bites the Dust emerged from my single-minded desire not to encounter you... Bring it on! Let's see you stop time! How long can you keep it up?
pages.overview: With your newfound confidence, Bites the dust plays more agressively then your old counterpart, if anything goes wrong, you can always revert time to a better time.

moves.name: Rush Attack
moves.does: The player does a five hit strike, last hit knockback and break block

moves.name: Another One Gone
moves.does: The player grabs forward, having the intent to grab someone’s face. If landed, they will grab the opponent’s face and blow them up, ragdolling them away. The player will then walk forward. If this were to kill, the opponent will turn to dust.

moves.name: Bites The Dust
moves.does: One of the player’s friends gets summoned as Hayato (their avatar gets shrunken down) and the player picks them up, after this they will throw them forward. If Hayato were to hit a player, a cutscene will begin where Hayato screams and the enemy looks surprised. After this, the camera will pan to the user where they will detonate Bites The Dust, creating a magic tube-like visual where they fall down it. After this, everyone hit will come back to their previous location 20 seconds ago. The KQ player will get their health back from 20 seconds ago however the enemies will be dealt 100 DMG instead. The BTD explosion can hit multiple opponents and bring them into the cutscene.

moves.name: Stray Cat
moves.does: The player aims forward and calculates their distance, after this they will shoot out a stray cat bubble that travels slowly. While this bubble is active, you can press B again to make it go to your cursor, the bubble can hit the user. Once the bubble hits someone it will explode and deals AOE damage.

moves.name: Staining The Pavement
moves.does: The player swipes forward, if landed, a cutscene will begin where the player slams the opponent repeatedly into the floor. Ending by grabbing the enemy from the collar and throwing them away

moves.name: Pocket Change
moves.does: The player picks up coins from their pockets and then throws them forward and detonates them, creating a wall AOE that stuns opponents.

pages.name: Superfly
pages.quote: Whats a god to a non believer?

moves.name: Summon
moves.does: The player screams out superfly and puts up their hand. If not cancelled, superfly will arise from the ground, trapping anyone into it. Superfly is bigger then shown in the anime

moves.name: Straight Hands
moves.does: The player punches forward, slightly moving forward. This move can be repeated very quickly but deals very, very small amounts of stun and damage. Does not cancel any kind of move. Two different animations, one punch with left other punch with right.

moves.name: Weave
moves.does: The player weaves with their head, if an enemy was to attack, they will dodge the attack. This ability has a five second cooldown, however succeeding with the move will remove its cooldown.

moves.name: Head Smash
moves.does: The player charges up a punch and then punches downward, ragdolling anyone to the floor.

moves.name: Metal Rod
moves.does: The player points forward and a metal beam comes out from Superfly and acts as a beam, ragdolling anyone. Can only be used with superfly

moves.name: All Out
moves.does: The player enters a counter stance, If hit during this a cutscene will begin where the player kicks the enemy away in slow motion, charging a punch that gets weaved. Both players will then enter a brawl, where it ends with the players both punching themselves. While this brawl happens, Superfly will slowly destroy itself. After this, the cutscene will end however the player will continue this move. now holding their hand up and taking up all the broken parts of  Superfly and making them float above themselves. This will make the player enter ALL OUT mode.

moves.name: Satisfied
moves.does: The player cannot die by reaching 0, instead, they now die from losing all flying metal. Getting ragdolled removes metal. After all of superfly's scrap is gone, the player dies.

moves.name: Metal Fists
moves.does: The player has imbued their fist with superfly, increasing the power output of all their moves.

moves.name: Right Back At You
moves.does: Instead of weaving, the player blocks. If this counters a move, damage will be reflected to the attacker by 30%. Has the same other properties as Weave

moves.name: Maximum Output
moves.does: The player leaps into the air and uses up a great amount of metal to build a canon. The player then fires it at their cursor, dealing massive damage to anyone hit.

pages.name: Red Hot Chili Pepper
pages.quote: I'll show you how slow your Stand really is!
pages.overview: RHCP focuses on building up its volt to boost itself, protecting the user while hitting sick guitar riffs to reach that goal. Treat your meter as your bank, not using it  almost at all unless at maximum energy.

moves.name: Energy Bank
moves.does: Almost all of RHCP's moves can be held, once held, they will eat the player's meter fast and give themselves a damage boost depending on the amount of meter used. This happens during the move startup. All moves that say held have this property

moves.name: Electrifying Melody
moves.does: The player hits the cord on their guitar,  sending out bolts of electricity forward, can be done five times, last hit dealing knockback and breaking block. Has the range of stand m1s

moves.name: Guitar Solo
moves.does:
The player stands still and starts playing their guitar for as long as they stay in this mode, or if an enemy ragdolls them.

When inside of the mode, in the bottom middle of the screen notes will start falling down in rythm to a song, the player will need to press 1,2,3,4,5 in time to hit them, suceeding will charge up RHCP (By granting 1 Meter per key hit), comboing granting even more. While in this mode you cannot interact with the inventory. Hitting these keys work while using a move or in stun. You can summon your stand while in this move. You can use moves in this mode as long as you aren't "Stunned". 

If the player were to SOMEHOW finish a full song, they will become estatic and for a minute, all of their moves will have NO STARTUP AT ALL with INFINITE METER

moves.name: Energy Discharge
moves.does: The player riffs on their guitar while RHCP circles around, once the circle is completed, an explosion of energy will happen, ragdolling any enemy

moves.name: Pilot
moves.does: Whitesnake YBA Pilot mode. The more meter you have, the faster you are in pilot and further you can go from your main body. You can move during Guitar Solo with this.

moves.name: Stepping Into The Scene
moves.does: The player stomps and bows their body to rift their guitar, sending shocks to any enemy near and stunning them.

moves.name: Shocking Turn Of Events
moves.does: RHCP charges up a punch and then does a right hook, ragdolling anyone and applying ELECTRIC to that person. For 3 seconds, if that player were to use a combat ability, they will get cancelled and take a small amount of damage.

moves.name: Pinky Slash
moves.does: RHCP Charges up and then slashes with its pinky finger, stunning anyone

moves.name: Lightning Fast
moves.does: RHCP charges up and then punches, its electric energy dispersing and acting like a projectile, ragdolls

moves.name: Rock On
moves.does: The player uses up all of their combo meter and lets out one final note, dealing an amount of damage in a set AOE that both depend on the music combo meter.

moves.name: The Fastest
moves.does: The player lets out one final riff and then RHCP punches forward, if landed

pages.name: The Wonder of U
pages.quote: The act of "pursuing" me is certain to become a severe "disaster" that is sent back to the attacker. That is because the "flow of calamity" is the "flow of reason"! The "logic" of this world is linked together in a continuous chain! To overcome that and reach me is not possible!
pages.overview: WOU focuses on building up your enemy's "Calamity Penalty" meter and then letting calamity judge them, dealing massive burst damage. Has a great defensive kit to ward off rushdown type stands.

moves.name: Rush Attacks
moves.does: The player does a strike forward, five charges, the last hit ragdolls and breaks block

moves.name: Downpour Alert
moves.does: WOU looks up while pointing at the sky. A static hitbox will then be cast where rain will fall down, stunning any enemy inside of it.

moves.name: Old Man's Consequence
moves.does: WOU swipes forward with its cane, sending enemies back. Adds a stack of Calamity Penalty.

moves.name: Shall Not Pass
moves.does: WOU puts both of his hands on his cane and strikes it downward. An active will be active of Calamity Energy, if an enemy were to enter, they will get a calamity bar and then calamity will activate. Also deals initial damage on the slam.

passives.name: Hidden Identity
passives.does: The player plays as Wonder of U. They cannot run or dash. Dashing will cause the player to leave a fake clone of themselves, teleporting themselves to the pressed key.

passives.name: Calamity Is Not A Force For Good
passives.does: Hitting enemies will initiate the "Calamity Penalty". A red meter will show above the enemy's head until calamity arrives, where it will judge them depending on this meter. There are notches on meter to easily see what level the enemy is on, there are five of them.

passives.name: Nor Does It Care About Evil
passives.does: Wonder Of U has a massive circle near him that only him can see. Inside this circle are 2 other tinier circles. This move will be the cause of what calamity does to the opponent trough certain moves.

passives.name: Never-Ending Force
passives.does: If the WOU would die, he will instead fade away like an illusion and appear very close, with 100 HP remaining. This takes 25 Meter and is on a 10 second cooldown.

passives.name: Natural Occurance
passives.does: Every 50 seconds, enemies in the second and closest circle near WOU will receive a popup above their head indicating calamity is coming. After one second, a calamity of depending severity will come and act upon the enemies. Requires the enemies to have atleast started the Calamity Penalty bar.

blocks.text: Talk To Gyro with a Steel Ball equipped.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I saw you using this and it was spinning so fast, how did you do that?

lines.speaker: p9139g0
lines.text: [Laughing] Nyo-Ho. It's a technique called SPIN. It uses the natural geometry of the world The Golden Ratio to create infinite rotation.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: WOW… I need you to teach me this technique.

lines.speaker: p9139g0
lines.text: Really, huh. Everyone wants to throw iron around until they realize how heavy it is.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: But I'm serious! I’ll do whatever it takes to learn spin.

lines.speaker: p9139g0
lines.text: Is that so? If you’re serious you have to prove it then, go find my teddy bear for me, I really miss it and I can’t sleep without it :( .

objectives.text: Bring Gyro's lost teddy bear back to him.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I brought you your lost teddy bear you asked for, now what?

lines.speaker: p9139g0
lines.text: Alright. You proved you can follow the instructions, however this is the start now comes the hard part.

lines.speaker: p9139g0
lines.text: Lesson One. Spin isn't raw strength, Spin is a supernatural rotational energy that enhances the destructive power of an object. What I want you to do is to feel this supernatural energy through your body.

lines.speaker: p9139g0
lines.text: You made it back. You’ve got the basics down, now what I want you to do is to train your body and reflexes. Take it over!

objectives.text: Perfect Block 15 Times a real player

lines.speaker: p9139g0
lines.text: You are improving a lot. but human muscle has limits. You have to believe in Spin.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: But how?!

lines.speaker: p9139g0
lines.text: Focus your vision! Close your eyes to the world and let them open for the Golden Ratio.

objectives.text: Believe in Spin (An arrow will appear showing you the path to the Golden Ratio, stand near the marked objects for 5secs for it to count) (total of 5 objects)

lines.speaker: p9139g0
lines.text: You see it now, the golden rectangle isn't something you create, it's everywhere. You just need to match your rotation with it.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: And what’s the point of that exactly?

lines.speaker: p9139g0
lines.text: Nature never stops, when you force a spin with just your arm the energy doesn't last and dies in seconds, but when you match your energy with the golden ratio, you are borrowing power from nature.

lines.speaker: p9139g0
lines.text: All because of the Golden Ratio.

objectives.text: To achieve the unlimited power of Golden Spin picture a rectangle and inside it there’s an infinite amount of rectangles and the central spots it forms a spiral which has unlimited power (Draw The Golden Spin, super small mini game like the squid games cookies challenge where you have to follow the lines to finish the cookie same but with the golden spin.)

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: So this is it? Have i reached the final lesson

lines.speaker: p9139g0
lines.text: No, keep moving forward. The final lesson is waiting for you, however the true rotation isn't just about kinetic energy or muscle, it's about what's in the heart.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: An animation will then play of a flag being warped into reality and taking away gyro. Until the player enters a new server, gyro will not be there anymore

objectives.text: it's truly a detour (A bar will appear that fills up the closer you are to valentine and goes down the further you are. This is not the one we already have, instead, this npc can spawn anywhere in TLA city. Killing the boss will finish the quest)

blocks.text: Once completed, the quest will finish and grant the manual

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You: I couldn't have done it without Gyro. Thank you for teaching me. Thank you for everything, Arigato Gyro.

keywords.name: Soft Knockback
keywords.text: Knockback that leads to a combo

keywords.name: QTE
keywords.text: Quick Time Event. For the most case, this is an outer circle that becomes smaller until it reaches an inner circle, where the player needs to press the indicated key at the right moment (When the outer circle reaches the inner circle)

keywords.name: Wakeup
keywords.text: When the enemy stops being ragdolled and gets into the getup animation
